title.value: HyenaDNA: Long-Range Genomic Sequence Modeling at Single Nucleotide Resolution
title.justification: The paper introduces a model named HyenaDNA for genomic sequence modeling.
title.quote: Leveraging Hyena’s new long-range capabilities, we present HyenaDNA, a genomic foundation model pretrained on the human reference genome with context lengths of up to 1 million tokens at the single nucleotide-level.

extractions.description: The paper describes HyenaDNA, a genomic foundation model that improves long-range genomic sequence modeling by leveraging a new architecture allowing for long context lengths and single nucleotide resolutions, overcoming the limitations of previous models that couldn't model long-range interactions in DNA efficiently. It suggests HyenaDNA can be adapted to novel genomic tasks without fine-tuning and achieves state-of-the-art results on genomic benchmarks.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily discusses the development and capabilities of a genomic modeling tool without a focus on climate or ecological sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Understanding and learning from DNA sequences has long been a goal of biologists and deep learning researchers, as its “language” encodes instructions essential for all living things.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on genomic sequence modeling, which does not directly align with any climate or ecological sustainable development categories.
primary_category.quote: The mapping from DNA instructions, genotypes, to observable function and traits, phenotypes, remains ongoing research effort.

primary_sub_category.quote: Overcoming the long-range limitations of current generation models could help drive the next wave of innovations in AI-powered drug discovery and therapeutics.
